ICS 59.080.30TXD 31Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes constructional details and other particulars of cotton cloth, bleached or dyed for PAGRIS and PAGS.1.2 This standard does not specify the general appearance, feel, etc, of the cloth (see also 4.3).2. REFERENCES2.1 The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standards indicated in Annex A.
